semanticReview.method: Cotejo semántico de fuente académica primaria de acceso público; se corrigió el alcance para ajustarlo exactamente a variedades, registros y conclusiones disponibles; APA 7/Evidence/assessEntry.
findings: Móia (2024) reports widespread contemporary use of the simple and compound pluperfect forms (with ter and haver) in written European and Brazilian Portuguese, in a relatively balanced distribution across the registers considered: newspaper writing, modern literary texts, and modern literary translations. Thus, “literary” is one documented register, not an exclusive label.
Localizador consultado: pp. 143–169 (abstract institucional), Resumen del artículo en el portal institucional de la Universidade de Lisboa, 20–23.
APA 7: Móia, T. (2024). The Portuguese pluperfect: Diversity of forms, polysemy and interaction with adjuncts. Probus, 36(1), 143–169. https://doi.org/10.1515/probus-2024-2008
limitations: No se conservan generalizaciones fuera de las variedades o registros analizados por la fuente.
